name: Tears of the Moon
summary: At the Temple of the Moon, Priestess A'moora grieves for Lady Sathrah. Once blessed by Elune, the spider now brings danger, and the Sisterhood seeks to ease her suffering and recover her sacred spinnerets.

sections.title: A Beloved Creature's Fall
sections.body: At the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, Priestess A'moora grieves for Lady Sathrah. Elune once blessed the spider. Beneath the night sky, Sathrah wove silver webs across Teldrassil's boughs, and evening mist gathered on them. The Sisterhood of Elune collected the shimmering dew for its healing power in sacred rites.

sections.title: Mercy for Sathrah
sections.body:
Lady Sathrah has fallen into madness, as has much of the wildlife on the young World Tree. Near Wellspring Lake in the northern reaches, her fury threatens travelers and her own unhatched broods. The Sisterhood cannot cleanse her while she is in a violent frenzy, so they have chosen to end her suffering as an act of mercy.

The priestesses mean to recover Sathrah's silvery spinnerets and dedicate her remains at Elune's altar. They pray the Moon Goddess will grant her peace and a pure rebirth.

faq.answer: Lady Sathrah is an ancient spider native to Teldrassil, once beloved by Elune. Her silvery webs caught the night mist, whose dew held healing power.

faq.q: Why does Lady Sathrah have to be killed?
faq.answer: Lady Sathrah has fallen into a madness that has spread through Teldrassil's wildlife. She is violent and dangerous to her offspring and others, so the Sisterhood means to slay her as an act of mercy.
Lady Sathrah is found in northern Teldrassil, near the shores of Wellspring Lake.

faq.q: What were Lady Sathrah's webs used for?
faq.answer: Lady Sathrah's webs caught the evening mist, forming silvery dew with healing powers. The Sisterhood of Elune kept it in the Temple of the Moon.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Tears of the Moon?
aliases: who gives tears of the moon
tears of the moon quest giver
faq.answer: Priestess A'moora gives this task to trusted Alliance adventurers at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

faq.q: What will the priestesses do with Sathrah's spinnerets?
faq.answer: The priestesses plan to offer Sathrah's spinnerets to Elune at the temple altar. They ask the goddess to accept Sathrah's spirit, bless her, and grant her a peaceful rebirth.

angles.text: As a Kaldorei, you know corruption in Teldrassil's wilds spares neither humble beasts nor Elune's sacred companions.
As a priest of the Sisterhood of Elune, you know mercy can call for a sorrowful strike and a ritual offering to return a corrupted soul to the Goddess's embrace.
As a druid, you see Sathrah's sudden ferocity and torment as another troubling sign of Teldrassil's imbalance. Restoring her spirit is necessary to the wild's health.
